title: Laparoscopic Measuring Device Study
brief_summary: This study is gathering opinions from surgeons on the usability of our laparoscopic measuring device.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adult patients with hernia defect that requires laparoscopic measurement

Exclusion Criteria:

* Minors
study_population: Patients whose physician has already decided that laparoscopic hernia repair surgery is the best route of treatment for a hernia defect.
